summary: Stride, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing an October 8 Cooperation Agreement with the Fivespan Partners investor group (Fivespan Partners, LP, Fivespan Partners Fund, Ltd, Fivespan Partners GP, LLC and Dylan Haggart). The settlement resolves an activist campaign: the investor group withdrew its 2026 annual-meeting director nominations, stockholder proposal and Delaware Section 220 books-and-records demand. Stride will appoint Haggart as an independent director effective October 30, 2026, nominate him for the 2026 slate, and appoint Dr. Steven Guttentag first as non-voting Board Observer, then as an independent director after the 2026 Annual Meeting; a Capital Allocation Committee is formed. Standstill, voting and non-disparagement covenants run until the earliest of the 2027 nomination deadline or breaches. Watch board composition, committee influence and whether the settlement precedes a push for capital returns.
